facility_roles.quote: We present the result of an experiment to measure the electric dipole moment (EDM) of the neutron at the Paul Scherrer Institute

intervals.label: data taking at the PSI ultracold neutron source (2015 to 2017)
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound: the analysed data were taken in 2015 and 2016. End: the n2EDM design report says the previous apparatus was "operated at PSI until 2017".
intervals.quote: A total of 54068 individual measurement cycles, during 2015 and 2016, were used to determine the change in the Larmor precession frequency of the neutron

intervals.label: completed
intervals.quote: The project builds on experience gained with the previous apparatus operated at PSI until 2017

name: nEDM experiment at PSI
notes: The previous-apparatus lineage (RAL/Sussex/ILL) is stated in the n2EDM design report: "This measurement was performed with the apparatus originally built by the RAL/Sussex/ILL collaboration ... and was also moved to the source of ultracold neutrons (UCNs) at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI)."

physics_goals.quote: We present the result of an experiment to measure the electric dipole moment (EDM) of the neutron at the Paul Scherrer Institute using Ramsey's method of separated oscillating magnetic fields with ultracold neutrons (UCN).
physics_goals.value: Measure the electric dipole moment of the neutron at the PSI ultracold neutron source using Ramsey’s method

summary.plain: The neutron electric-dipole-moment experiment that ran at the Paul Scherrer Institute until 2017. Its 2020 result found the neutron’s dipole moment consistent with zero, with an uncertainty of about one part in 10^26 of an electron charge times a centimetre.
summary.technical: nEDM at PSI: Ramsey method of separated oscillating magnetic fields with ultracold neutrons, Hg-199 co-magnetometer and an array of optically pumped caesium magnetometers; d_n = (0.0 ± 1.1 stat ± 0.2 sys) x 10^-26 e cm from 54068 cycles in 2015-2016. Apparatus originally built by RAL/Sussex/ILL; successor n2EDM.
